title: perf(opencypher): 리터럴 구분자 split()에서 정규식 제거
body:
**base:** `main` = upstream `9415bd3bd` (2026-09-16). 우리 fork에서 먼저 검토한 뒤 upstream(ArcadeData/arcadedb)에 영문으로 올립니다.

## 요약
`split(str, delim)`은 구분자를 `Pattern.quote`로 감싸 `String.split`에 넘겼습니다. 감싼 형태(`\Q...\E`)는 `String.split`의 빠른 경로에 해당하지 않아서, 한 글자 구분자라도 호출마다, 즉 행마다 `Pattern`이 컴파일됐습니다. JDK 21에서 `"a,b,c"`를 이렇게 split하면 호출당 약 1,040 bytes를 할당합니다(빠른 경로는 232 bytes). LightRAG의 구분자는 `<SEP>`입니다. 이제 `indexOf`로 구분자를 찾습니다. 결과 조각은 같습니다(겹치지 않는 모든 구분자 기준, 앞·중간·끝의 빈 조각 유지).

## 측정
14,289행 `split(e.source_id, '<SEP>')` 스캔: 26 → 17 ms

## 테스트
- **`CypherSplitLiteralDelimiterTest`:** 결과를 `str.split(Pattern.quote(d), -1)`과 비교합니다. 정규식 문법 구분자, 자기 겹침 구분자, 양 끝 구분자, 빈 입력, surrogate pair를 다룹니다.
- **관련 테스트:** 이 브랜치 단독으로 55건 통과했습니다.

## upstream
이 PR을 upstream에 먼저 올릴 **탐색용 PR**로 정했습니다. 변경이 작고 효과와 동치성이 분명하기 때문입니다.

<details><summary>upstream용 영문 초안</summary>

## Issue

**Title:** `Two allocation hot spots on Cypher scans: split() compiles a Pattern per row, PageId.hashCode() boxes on every page read`

**Body:**

1. **`split()` compiles a regex on every call.** `split(str, delim)` passes `Pattern.quote(delim)` to `String.split`. The quoted form never qualifies for `String.split`'s fast path, so every call (once per row) compiles a `Pattern`, even for a one-character delimiter. LightRAG uses `<SEP>`. On a 14,289-row scan of `split(e.source_id, '<SEP>')`, the query takes 26 ms.
2. **`PageId.hashCode()` allocates on almost every page read.** `PageId.hashCode()` calls `Objects.hash(database, fileId, pageNumber)`, which allocates a varargs array and boxes two ints. A `PageId` is created for each page read and looked up in the page cache right away, so the cached hash is almost never reused. In a Cypher scan over 14,289 multi-page vertex records, this call accounted for about a quarter of the samples.

---

## PR (split)

**Title:** `perf(#NNNN): split on a literal delimiter without a regex`

- **What it does:** the delimiter is now found with `indexOf`. The pieces are the same: every non-overlapping occurrence, left to right, with empty leading, inner and trailing pieces kept.
- **Test:** `CypherSplitLiteralDelimiterTest` compares the result with `str.split(Pattern.quote(d), -1)`. It covers regex-syntax delimiters, a self-overlapping delimiter, delimiters at either end, an empty input and surrogate pairs.
- **Result:** 26 → 17 ms on the scan above.

---

## Benchmark setup (referenced from each PR as "Setup")

- **Data:** one LightRAG knowledge-graph workspace: 14,289 entity vertices under one label, 25,191 `DIRECTED` edges, and long `description` / `source_id` strings, so most vertex records span more than one page.
- **Server:** ArcadeDB in Docker (`arcadedata/arcadedb`, arm64, 4 GB VM), with the engine jar built from the branch.
- **Client:** the Python neo4j driver over Bolt.
- **Timing:** medians of 15–30 runs after warm-up, stock and patched jar measured against the same data.
- **Reference:** Neo4j on the same data, where quoted.

## Verification common to every PR

- **Build:** `mvn -pl engine test` with the openCypher test classes (`-Dtest=com/arcadedb/query/opencypher/*Test,com/arcadedb/query/opencypher/**/*Test`) and `-DargLine=-Xmx1500m`.
- **`Issue6216AlgoWorkKnobBoundsTest`:** fails with an OutOfMemoryError under that heap on unpatched `main` as well.
- **`MergeInsertSlowdownTest`:** runs on its own, because the 4 GB Docker VM kills the fork when it shares a run.

## Results on base 9415bd3bd (2026-09-17)

**All six perf topics together** (`perf/opencypher-in-index-orderby-keys`, rebased): the openCypher suite ran 5611 tests with 1 failure, `Issue6216`.

**Each topic branch alone**, with its own test class plus the neighbouring openCypher and engine test classes. Every run had 0 failures:

| Topic branch | Tests run |
|---|---:|
| in-index | 518 |
| orderby | 61 |
| count | 171 |
| split | 55 |
| pageid | 95 |
| where-once | 256 |

**Temporal fix.** The run covered the openCypher, serializer and schema tests, plus the `*Temporal*`, `*Date*`, `*Json*` and `*Duration*` tests.
- 6427 tests ran, with 5 failures.
- None of the 5 failures is caused by the change:
  - `Issue6216` is the known heap failure.
  - `Issue6114AtomicSchemaWriteTest` fails 4 of its 12 tests on unpatched 9415bd3bd too, in the same Docker build.
- `CypherTemporalStorageRoundTripTest`: 17 of 17 passed.

`MergeInsertSlowdownTest` passed when run on its own, on both the perf branch and the fix branch.

</details>
